title: A LATE TEAMMATE IS TOLD ABOUT BODIES THAT CAME UP AFTER THE BUILD
why: A teammate who joined a raid in progress got the host raid and the bodies already down, but not the words about bodies that came up after the build (THE OVERSEER, and anyone else who walked in later). Its window drew them from the position updates alone: the boss had no name, no boss bar and a plain warden size. The host now sends those words right after the raid word, for those bodies only.
now: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS: a teammate who joins late now sees THE OVERSEER and anyone who came up after the start with their names and sizes, as the host does.
